Minor release with new **Range** and **Speed Dial** components, plus broad styling and showcase improvements.

### Added

- **Range** field component with `NumericRange` type and showcase.
- **Speed Dial** component with showcase.
- Markdown asset paths in showcase documentation page configurations.
- `ignoreWithinSelector` on **Table of Content** for finer heading filtering.
- Fade-in animation on **Tooltip**.
- Toast exit animation and improved stack behavior.

### Changed

- **Card** — border style options; removed `size` property.
- **Badge** — default shape changed from `rounded` to `circular`.
- **Data Grid**, **Tree** / **Tree Node**, **Toast**, **Splitter** — structure and styling improvements.
- **Kbd**, **Color**, **State Base** SCSS — consistency updates.
- **Time** and date panel components — unified styling.
- Showcase theme drawer and sidebar refactored.

### Removed

- **Video** component and showcase (removed from public API).

### Fixed

- Background color consistency in **Time Picker**, **Time Span**, and **Radio Button Group**.

### Install

```bash
npm install @laczynski/ui@1.1.0
```

Docs: https://ui.laczynski.dev/
